about.title: About this project
about.p1: Promise to Palestine began from the heart: a belief that compassion should not stop at a border. We bring people together to send food, clean water, medical care and shelter to families who need it.
about.p2: The word promise is deliberate. A gift is a single moment. A promise is a commitment to keep showing up, which is why you can give once or every month.
about.transparencyText: We publish how funds are allocated, share updates as work is delivered, and never show your email or card details.
